invariants.rationale: The Option object returned by the method should not be null, assuming Option is a non-nullable return wrapper type.
Method parameter context is expected to be a valid engine context, so should not be null at method exit.
Method parameter instantTime (being a String representing an instant) is not expected to be null.
The method is expected to operate on a valid instantTime, which typically is not an empty string in such contexts.
The Option object passed as extraMetadata should not be null as a method parameter.
